{{Codex|While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.}}

The '''Spectra''' is a {{Faction|Corpus}} handheld cutting laser that is as effective at cutting flesh as it is at cutting metal. It is essentially a sidearm version of the {{Weapon|Flux Rifle}}.

This weapon can be sold for {{cc|5,000}}.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage.
*Damage ramps up from 25% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 25% over 2 seconds.
*Innate 0.5 meter [[punch through]].
*Can use the Spectra-exclusive {{M|Sequence Burn}} mod.

{{Advantages|class=Pistol|trigger=Held|
*Pinpoint [[accuracy]].
**{{M|Magnum Force}}'s accuracy penalty is minimal on this weapon.
*Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage.
}}

{{Disadvantages|class=Pistol|trigger=Held|
*Limited range of 18 meters.
}}

{{WeaponComparison|Spectra Vandal}}

==Acquisition==
The Spectra's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Energy Lab|Energy Lab]] in the [[dojo]].

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Tips==
*As with the {{Weapon|Flux Rifle}}, multishot mods (in this case {{M|Barrel Diffusion}}) are essential to maximize output. {{M|Lethal Torrent}} can be used to further increase damage.
**Increasing the fire rate with Lethal Torrent will drastically increase ammo consumption.
*Using the {{M|Pistol Ammo Mutation}} mod can help regain lost ammo when needed. Alternatively, use {{M|Pistol Scavenger}} Aura or bring along [[Squad Ammo Restore]].
*Similar building with the Flux Rifle, adding {{M|Magnum Force}} to the Spectra can actually be beneficial, as the shooter does not require precise aiming. This will further reduce its medium range effectiveness however. 
*{{M|Ruinous Extension}} and {{M|Sequence Burn}} can bring up the Spectra's range to rival those of Primary beam weapons.

==Trivia==
*The Spectra is currently known to be one of the most improved weapons throughout the game's patches, as it was one of the weakest [[Clan Dojo]] [[Research]] weaponry ever released: It used to deal a total of 8 damage per second.
*Spectra is the plural form of [[wikipedia:Spectrum|Spectrum]].
*During the final phases of the Arid Fear event, the [[Scout|Corpus Scouts]] were equipped with Spectras, which they would use for short durations before attempting to run.
*Ceasing fire from the Spectra actually retracts the beam instead of it disappearing.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|22.14}}
*Fixed Beam weapons not being able to damage enemies (alive but in a ragdolled state) when being affected by certain ‘crowd control’ Abilities.
*Damage now ramps up over 0.6 seconds and after moving off target there is a delay of 0.8 seconds before it starts to decay over 2 seconds.
*All Beam weapons now start their Damage ramp up at 20% (instead of 10%).
*The Multishot chance should now apply more consistently with Beam weapons.
*Fixed Beam weapons continuously firing when quick Meleeing.

{{ver|22.13.4}}
*Increased the Beam weapon Damage ramp up time from 0.8 to 1 second.
*Fixed Beam weapon Damage ramp up not happening per target.

{{ver|22.13.3}}
*Perfect accuracy and high fire rate is balanced by limited range and damage ramping up from 10% to 100% over 0.8 seconds when firing and decays back to 10% over 1 second after stopping.
*Damage changed from 30 Physical per sec to 18 Physical per tick.
*Physical damage changed from 10% Impact, 70% Puncture and 20% Slash to 0% Impact, 42% Puncture and 58% Slash.
*Fire Rate increased from 5 to 12.
*Status Chance increased from 20% per sec to 22% per tick of damage.
*Critical chance increased from 5% to 14%.
*Reload reduced from 2s to 1.8s.
*Magazine size reduced from 80 to 60.
*Added 0.5 meter Punch Through.
*Range increased from 15m to 18m.
*Ammo consumption decreased from 1.0 to 0.5 per tick of damage.
*Aimed Zoom reduced from 2.23x to 1.6x.

{{ver|14.2}}
*Spectra & Flux Rifle:
**Both are now more Ammo efficient.
**More base ammo in clips.
**Faster fire rate.
**Damage Increases for both weapons.

{{ver|9}}
*Introduced.

'''Stabilizer''' is a rifle [[mod]] that reduces the [[recoil]] produced from firing a weapon by 15% per rank for a maximum of 60% at Rank 3.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
* This mod can also be stacked with {{M|Vile Precision}} and {{M|Gun Glide}}, which will provide a combined [[recoil]] reduction of -140%. The excess -40% reduction will not be utilized in the process.
* This mod reduces the distance the aiming reticle is shaken when fired, however it doesn't help increase the gun's base [[accuracy]].

==Tips==
*Works well with the {{Weapon|Latron}} and {{Weapon|Latron Prime}}, as you can land more headshots in less time due to not having to wait as long for the gun to stabilize.
*Helps the [[recoil]] of the {{Weapon|Grakata}}, {{Weapon|Gorgon}}, {{Weapon|Supra}}, and {{Weapon|Trumna}} as they mostly have vertical [[recoil]], which is almost completely negated by the mod.

==Trivia==
*Prior to {{ver|16.7}}, this mod was usable in [[PvP]] games until it was replaced by its own specific PvP mods along with a number of other mods: {{M|Quickdraw}}, {{M|Fast Hands}}, {{M|Slip Magazine}}, {{M|Tactical Pump}}, {{M|Steady Hands}}, {{M|Burdened Magazine}}, {{M|Magazine Warp}} and {{M|Terminal Velocity}}.

{{Top|Enemy|Infested|Infested|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|This long-distance sniper rifle fires a razor-sharp, virus-soaked barb that continues to attack its host before violently erupting in a spore-laden mist. Scoped headshots increase lethality.}} '''Sporothrix''' is an {{Faction|Infested}} [[Sniper Rifle]] that shoots explosive delayed {{D|Viral}} barbs, while boasting very high damage, [[critical multiplier]], and [[status chance]], that is offset by its near nonexistent [[critical chance]]. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage. *One zoom mode that has 2.7x zoom distance and +50% headshot damage. *Shots explode in a '''1.7''' meter [[AoE]] radius after '''0.9''' seconds on impacting a surface or enemy. **Explosion deals innate {{D|Viral}} damage. **Explosion delay reduces likelihood of inflicting [[Stagger|self-stagger]], but may allow enemies to move out of the explosion range if not directly hit by the projectile. **Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Explosion does not affect combo counter. *Can use the Sporothrix-exclusive {{M|Volatile Variant}} mod. *Can benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) and {{M|Cautious Shot}}. *Innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity. {{Advantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Highest [[status chance]] of all sniper rifles, and second highest status chance of all weapons behind {{Weapon|Bubonico}} alt-fire. *Pinpoint [[accuracy]] while [[zoom]]ed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for [[Enemy Body Parts|headshots]]. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Second lowest [[critical chance]] of all weapons, after {{Weapon|Deconstructor}} and {{Weapon|Deconstructor Prime}}. *Projectiles have travel time. *Shots have linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 50% from 400m to 600m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Extremely inaccurate when fired from the hip. *Only one [[zoom]] mode, reducing its effectiveness at long ranges. *Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. *Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. *Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 90% from central impact. }} {{WeaponComparison|Coda Sporothrix}} ==Acquisition== The Sporothrix's blueprint and components can be acquired from Lvl 50-60 [[Isolation Vault|Isolation Vault Bounties]] (normal and Arcana). The blueprint and components can also be purchased from [[Loid]] after reaching '''Rank 3 - Clearance: Odima''' with {{Faction|Necraloid}}, requiring {{sc|8,000}} for the blueprint and {{sc|6,000}} for each of the components. The blueprint and all components can be [[Trading|traded]]. {{Acquisition|name=Sporothrix|header=n}} {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Tips== *Despite being a sniper rifle primarily intended against single targets, the exploding barbs make Sporothrix equally valuable as a crowd control weapon. Aiming at grouped enemies is a good way of maximizing the weapon's effectiveness. *Can equip the [[Volatile Variant]] augment mod which grants AOE damage. *There are several ways to make use of the Sporothrix's high critical damage by adding flat critical chance bonuses: **{{Companion|Adarza Kavat}} {{M|Cat's Eye}} periodically grants an additive 60% boost to critical chance. **{{Companion|Smeeta Kavat}}'s {{M|Charm}} periodically grants a fixed 200% critical chance as one of its possible effects. **With another player using the {{Weapon|Mutalist Quanta}}'s [[Alternate Fire]], shooting through the orb adds a flat +25% critical chance, in addition to +25% critical damage and extra {{D|Electricity}}. **{{WF|Harrow}}'s {{A|Covenant}} can add up to +50% additive crit chance, or +200% on headshots, after absorbing enough damage. **A fully ranked {{Arcane|Arcane Avenger}} has a 21% chance upon receiving damage to grant +45% flat critical chance. **{{WF|Mesa}}'s {{M|Ballistic Bullseye}} allows for a single bullet and subsequent explosion to gain an additive critical chance bonus, scaling with [[Ability Strength]]. **{{WF|Citrine}}'s {{A|Crystallize}} spawns a large crystal growth on enemies, shooting the growth inflicts a fixed 300% critical chance. **{{WF|Sevagoth}}'s {{M|Shadow Haze}} adds a flat +50% additive critical chance when attacking enemies inflicted with{{A|Reap}} or {{A|Death's Harvest}}. ==Trivia== *This weapon shares its name with the real-world fungus genus ''[[wikipedia:Sporothrix|Sporothrix]]''. One particular species can cause [[wikipedia:Sporotrichosis|Sporotrichosis]] in humans and animals, otherwise known as "Rose Gardener's Disease". ==Gallery== Sporothrix (1).png|Sporothrix when shown in the arsenal Sporothrix (2).png File:Tim-bergholz-chamferzone-com-sporothrix-infested-sniper-rifle-timbergholz.jpg File:Tim-bergholz-chamferzone-com-screenshot151.jpg File:Tim-bergholz-chamferzone-com-screenshot149.jpg File:Tim-bergholz-chamferzone-com-Infested-Sniper-screenshot150.jpg File:Tim-bergholz-chamferzone-com-q-infestedsniper-3-4.jpg|Concept art File:Tim-bergholz-chamferzone-com-q-infestedsniper-profile.jpg {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|42}} *Added the following items to Necraloid’s Wares in the Necralisk: **Sporothrix’s Blueprint and Components (available at Clearance: Odima). {{ver|38.5}} *Improved performance issues with Sporothrix, especially in conjunction with its Augment. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *Sporothrix ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage. Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall. *Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions. **This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage. {{ver|29.5.9}} ;Sporothrix and Arum Spinosa Blueprints are now tradable! To balance out the Weapon Blueprint drop % reduction we’ve made the Sporothrix and Arum Spinosa Blueprints tradable. The Sporothrix and Arum Spinosa parts were already Tradable, but it’s now one step further. {{ver|29.5.3}} *Fixed the actual base Blueprint for the new Sporothrix not being in Rotation A of Deimos: Arcana Bounties. Sporothrix Blueprint is now in Rotation A at 21%. {{ver|29.5}} *Introduced. }} ==See Also== *{{Weapon|Coda Sporothrix}}, the [[Coda Weapons|Coda]] variant of the same weapon. *{{Weapon|Catabolyst}}, a secondary that shares the same visual theme. *{{Weapon|Pulmonars}}, a melee weapon that shares the same visual theme. *{{Weapon|Arum Spinosa}}, a war fan obtainable through the same missions. {{WeaponNav}} [[fr:Sporothrix]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Viral Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Augmented Weapons]] [[uk:Споротрикс]]

==Notes==
*Singularities last for '''5''' seconds.
*Orbs that trigger a singularity do not explode.
*Singularities can be triggered by contact with teammates or allies and will remain attached to them after triggering.
*Setting the second energy color to black will significantly reduce the brightness of the singularity without causing the overall effect to disappear.
